sloka: अयम् हि सुप्तः ष्ण्मासान् कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।सर्वशस्त्रभृतम् मुख्यः स इदानीम् समुत्थितः ॥६-१२-११॥।।
transliteration: ayam hi suptaḥ ṣṇmāsān kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।sarvaśastrabhṛtam mukhyaḥ sa idānīm samutthitaḥ ॥6-12-11॥।।

translations.english: "Kumbhakarna, the foremost among the wielders of weapons, is very strong. He was sleeping these six months and has arrived now."
